name: R-13: every public Papercusp repository declares a license
command: gh repo list Papercusp --visibility public --limit 100 --json name,licenseInfo
summary: 47 public repositories; 0 with null licenseInfo. The one earlier gap (sidestage) was a default-branch problem: its ELv2 LICENSE was on staging while main was frozen by that repo's red gate. The default branch is now staging (D-019).

assertions.evidence: At 06:18Z the same query returned sidestage with null licenseInfo, so the check can fail.
